notes.hook: music-only 'Fat Loss Journey | Before After Transformation' with no numbers in the title
notes.what_goes_wrong: A generic 'fat loss journey before after' with no kg or time span; the 25-niche data had vague 'transformation' labels at 0.21x while '135 kg to 63 kg' got 10M (visuals unchecked).
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: 'transformation journey' with no numbers; put the kg and the months in the first frame.
